blocks.x: Golden paths turn engineering months into days — and make the secure path the easy path.
Platform engineering is the highest-use hire you will make. Backstage-class catalogs with scorecards make ownership visible and drift actionable.
DORA metrics belong on the platform team's roadmap, not just engineering's vanity dashboard.
Platform-as-product (roadmap, budget, NPS) separates adopted platforms from routed-around ones.
Where it breaks in practice: lift-and-shift economics: estates migrated without unit-cost telemetry, so the savings case quietly erodes while the bill grows more opaque.
The serious opposition goes: the unit-economics thesis can excuse under-provisioning that costs more in incidents than it saves in compute. FinOps is a balance, not a crusade.
How we put it to work

In delivery, this thesis becomes a specific discipline: infrastructure is treated as a product: versioned, observable, costed, and handed to your team with runbooks rather than folklore. Every program in the Cloud, Edge & Platform domain carries the same obligations — a signed baseline, named gate criteria, and evidence generated by running the system rather than preparing for a meeting.
Start with the diagnostic, not the contract: this position baselined against your estate in two weeks, and a scoped proposal only if the delta justifies it.
